svg.title: Aconcagua / Casablanca study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Aconcagua; 2: Casablanca; 3: Panquehue; 4: San Felipe; 5: Los Andes; 6: Llaillay; 7: Putaendo; 8: Santiago; 9: Valparaíso; 10: San Antonio; 11: San Bernardo; 12: Quillota

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
